summary: Frontend-only verification completed for Golden Chariot static site on public URL. All requested user flows passed, including slider auto-advance, quote modal validation/submit/close, mobile menu+quote flow, placeholder review carousel controls, Global Trade and Private Label sections, and WhatsApp link presence.

rca of the issue: No product bug found in requested scope. Two intermediate Playwright actionability failures occurred while filling quote modal after forced invalid submit; final verification used native form validity + successful submit flow and confirmed functional behavior.
